verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents on-call schedules for a team. A schedule is a collection of rotations, and each rotation defines the timing and assignment of on-call shifts. A changelog entry notes preserved schedule overrides, so the core rotation-based scheduling is first-party. Multiple rotations per schedule implies layering, but time-zone handling and round-robin coverage are never described. missing for 10: explicit layer configuration docs, time-zone support, round-robin assignment, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can build on-call schedules with rotations, layers, time zones, and round-robin coverage that match how my teams actually work
